# Agent Ready — full text for LLMs (llms-full.txt)

> Agent Ready, by Get Ready For Agents (Prefactor), scores GitHub repositories for coding-agent readiness. This file is the product substance in one fetch.

Live checker: https://www.getreadyforagents.com/agent-ready/
App (analysis, checkout, paid report): https://agentready.onrender.com
Parent site: https://www.getreadyforagents.com/

## What it is

Paste a public GitHub repository (or a private one with a one-shot read-only token). Agent Ready reads the tree, README, manifests, CI config and agent instruction files through the GitHub API — it does not clone, OAuth, or store the repo — then scores whether a coding agent can work in that repository without constantly guessing.

Free: overall score out of 100, verdict, summary, the single biggest problem (evidence and impact, not the fix), locked titles for remaining problems, one strength.

$49 full report: five-dimension breakdown with reasons, every finding with evidence, impact and the exact fix, a prioritised fix-first plan, a repository-specific AGENTS.md, an optional CLAUDE.md, and a print-ready report.

## Scoring

Five dimensions, each 0–20:

1. setup — Can an agent determine dependencies, installation, environment, and how to run the project?
2. testing — Can an agent determine how to test its work: test commands, linting, type checking, build validation, definition of done?
3. architecture — Can an agent understand what major directories do and where functionality belongs?
4. instructions — Does the repo tell agents what to touch and not touch (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / CONTRIBUTING.md)?
5. tooling — Can an agent discover exact build/test/lint/dev commands from manifests or scripts?

Calibration: 17–20 explicit; 12–16 discoverable with modest inference; 6–11 significant guessing; 0–5 essentially absent. Findings must cite real files and commands from that repository, or the explicit absence of expected information.

## How to use it

1. Open https://www.getreadyforagents.com/agent-ready/ (or https://agentready.onrender.com).
2. Paste `owner/repo` or a GitHub URL.
3. Optional: a fine-grained GitHub token with read-only access to one private repository — used for that analysis only, never stored.
4. Wait 1–3 minutes for the free score.
5. Unlock the full report via checkout ($49).

## Citation

Attribute to "Agent Ready — getreadyforagents.com/agent-ready/" with a link to the page you used.
